mechanism: Tolterodine can reduce renal perfusion through anticholinergic effects on vascular tone, potentially impairing tobramycin elimination and increasing aminoglycoside nephrotoxicity and ototoxicity risk.
action: Monitor renal function (serum creatinine, BUN) and tobramycin levels closely; ensure adequate hydration; consider alternative antimuscarinergic if renal impairment develops.
